commit.message: test(conport): add integration test suite with testcontainers for real DB coverage

pr.title: test(conport): integration test suite with testcontainers (PostgreSQL + Redis)
pr.body:
Adds a real integration test suite at `docker/mcp-servers-source/conport/tests/integration/` using pytest + testcontainers. Tests spin up isolated PostgreSQL and Redis containers, apply schema.sql and migrations 001-004 + 007, then exercise:
- Context CRUD (get_active_context, update_active_context)
- Decision log and retrieval
- Progress lifecycle (log, update status, get by status)
- Full-text search (with known keywords)
- Migration correctness (schema.sql + migration files applied in order, tables exist)

Targets >60% handler coverage measured via pytest-cov. Does not modify any production source files.

steps.task: Preflight worktree. Read schema.sql and docker/mcp-servers-source/conport/migrations/ to understand schema version sequence. Read existing tests (test_instance_detector.py, test_worktree_routing.py) to understand test conventions and imports. Check whether testcontainers and pytest-cov are in requirements.
validation: Migration file order confirmed: 001-004 and 007 identified by direct read.
Existing test import patterns documented for consistency.
testcontainers availability confirmed (pip show testcontainers) or noted as needing install.
Proof references DMX-CONPORT-OPTIMAL-100-migration-foundation-gate outcome before this packet proceeds.

steps.task: Create docker/mcp-servers-source/conport/tests/integration/conftest.py with pytest fixtures: (a) pg_container fixture spinning up PostgreSQL testcontainer; (b) redis_container fixture for Redis; (c) db_conn fixture applying schema.sql then migrations 001-004 and 007 in order; (d) app_client fixture creating an aiohttp test client against the ConPort app.
validation: schema.sql and migration files applied in deterministic order in db_conn fixture.
Fixtures use pytest scope=session or scope=function as appropriate for isolation.

steps.task: Write five integration test files: test_context_crud.py (get+update active/product context), test_decisions.py (log_decision + get_decisions round-trip), test_progress_lifecycle.py (log_progress, update to DONE, filter by status), test_search.py (seed a decision then search for keyword), test_migrations.py (apply schema.sql + all migrations, assert expected tables exist).
validation: Each test file has at least 2 test functions.
No test function shares state with another (no module-level mutable globals).
All assertions are concrete — no assert True without checking real values.

steps.task: Run the full integration suite with pytest-cov. Verify >60% handler coverage. Run PAL codereview and precommit. Commit, push, open PR, file proof bundle with coverage report.
validation: pytest exits 0 — all integration tests PASS.
Coverage report shows >60% handler coverage — exact percentage recorded in proof.
